protocol.candidate: fixed full I/P initial v1 models; I picture feedback safety constraint
protocol.target_rate: rounded actual Annex-B bps from corresponding 300-frame native CQP baseline
protocol.evaluation: mean per-picture Y-PSNR and cosine-row Y-WS-PSNR; actual bps; common-range PCHIP BD-rate
protocol.timing: elapsed wall seconds under concurrent scheduling; not isolated speed benchmark
protocol.decoded_files: independently verified then temporary decoded copies removed; encoded reconstructions retained
protocol.job_order: largest target first to reduce long-tail idle time
protocol.reconstruction: independent decoder only; temporary files removed after exact size and quality/hash evaluation
protocol.reconstruction_identity_gate: 16-frame full SIBRC VVC and both traces exactly match validated encoder-reconstruction run
protocol.io_pilot: partial reconstruction-output pilot cancelled and archived; excluded from results
protocol.evaluation_pipeline: bounded independent decoder pipeline plus per-frame metric evaluation; at most two temporary reconstructions on fast disk
